voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In August of nineteen sixty-six, a boy was flying a kite on a hill above Rio.
He found two men lying in the grass, side by side. They wore suits, and lead masks over their eyes.
No wounds. No blood. No sign of struggle. Just the two of them, an empty water bottle, and two wet towels.
In a pocket, a note. Six thirty: swallow the capsules. After the effect: protect the metals. Await the signal.
By the time the autopsy was performed, the organs were too decomposed to test. No one ever determined what killed them.
